primary_recovery_definition: Proxy recovery rate = successful, exact-deduplicated payment amount in month / static account-master outstanding amount. The dataset does not provide a monthly opening balance, so this is not a true accounting recovery rate.
payment_cleaning: Drop exact duplicate rows. Preserve unique payment_id records even when payment_reference is reused across accounts; flag reused references instead of assuming they are duplicates.
call_cleaning: Drop exact duplicate rows. Exclude call_ids with conflicting duplicate records from primary call metrics and retain them in rejected/conflicting_calls.csv.
identity_rule: Use accounts.account_id -> accounts.borrower_id as the master relationship. Preserve original event borrower_id for audit but replace analytical borrower_id with account master when available.
campaign_rule: Do not treat daily_targeting rows outside campaign start/end as valid campaign exposure without qualification; flag them for investigation.
timezone_rule: Do not overwrite source timestamps in raw. A production implementation should canonicalize to UTC while retaining source timezone; this submission flags timezone inconsistencies rather than fabricating corrections.
causal_rule: Strategy/channel comparisons are descriptive only because targeting is observational and campaign windows contain inconsistencies. A controlled experiment is required before treating observed lift as causal.
time_window: January through July 2026 are treated as complete months for trend comparison. August 2026 is partial and excluded from MoM headline comparisons.
